_comment: Component-reuse MCP stack for WALTEUR. Ordering is deliberate: prefer existing components over writing new ones, and prefer the source that cannot meter or poison a build loop. shadcn is PRIMARY because it is first-party, needs no API key, is unmetered, returns full file contents plus the exact add command, and is multi-registry - so it reaches the 21st, shadcnblocks, Magic UI and bklit registries through one tool surface via components.json. 21st is SECONDARY and must stay fully degradable: on the free tier it allows 2 installs/day and, critically, a quota-exhausted search returns HTTP 200 with limitReached:true and the results array REPLACED BY AGENT-FACING UPSELL COPY - an unguarded loop will paste marketing text into a component file. Treat 21st tools being absent as a normal state. Retry policy to mirror: retryable on 408/425/429/500/502/503/504, 409 explicitly NOT retryable, honour Retry-After.
